annotations.title: Raiſe ſede to thy brother.
annotations.text: <mn>[1]</mn> By this it appeareth, that in the law of nature, when a maried man died without iſſue, his brother might lawfully marie the widow: whoſe firſt ſonne ſhould be counted and called the ſonne and heyre of his vncle dead before. The ſame was eſtabliſhed by the law of Moyſes (Deut. 25) VVhich being now abrogated, it remaineth in the Churches powre to conſtitute a law in this behalf, <mn>[2]</mn>and conſequently to diſpenſe in the ſame, ſo farre as is agreable with the law of nature. VVherof ſee more. Leuit. 18.

notes.text: How a man might marie his brothers wife in the law of nature. The Churches decree is now our rule.
The Church's decree is now our rule.
